capture_steps: For each source commit, build client and UI with node web/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc using web/tsconfig.build.json and web/packages/ui/tsconfig.json, restart Vite from web/apps/dev on 127.0.0.1:5196, navigate to ?fixture=actual, resize to 1280x720 and 390x844, and capture the complete SVG floor element at each viewport so both desks and their lower legs are visible.
inspection: Tasks tray artwork is centered within the Tasks tabletop.
Missions and Work tables maps cover their tabletops with a one-pixel inset.
Break room coffee station is rendered with two support brackets; bookshelf remains visible as a separate fixture.
